title: Propagate cancellation from Module execution
goal: Ensure cancellation from ModuleRuntime propagates through M6 without being recorded as an ordinary failed action or observation.
context: M6 executeProposal catches every ModuleRuntime error and converts it into a normal failed action. When ModuleRuntime throws its explicit cancelled error, this produces misleading actionExecuted/observationProduced events before cancellation is noticed by the outer loop.
forbidden_changes: Do not convert ModuleRuntimeError.cancelled or task cancellation into a normal execution failure.
Do not alter ordinary Module failure handling.
Do not change ModuleRuntime timeout semantics or claim a cancelled action completed.
acceptance_criteria: CancellationError and ModuleRuntimeError.cancelled propagate as CancellationError from executeProposal.
The regression confirms ModuleRuntime emits moduleCancelled for the target module.
A cancelled module invocation emits no ordinary actionExecuted or observationProduced event.
Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA pass on the final PR head.
verification: Confirm Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA pass on the final PR head.
recovery: Handle cancellation before the generic failure branch and assert no ordinary action outcome is emitted for the cancelled Module.
